answer: The admission bond is time locked for 5 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are published in forge, expire in cipher, and prism lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 172 aliases thus needs 37 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3562 identities would post 3755 proofs and burn roughly 5 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
